intent_check.summary: The forward arm (L3H1) meets the backward arm (U_info). Restoring L3H1's clean output recovers R_L3=0.829 of the coupling (matching readout_path's 0.818), and 93% of that routes through U_info (R_U=0.770) versus <=0.047 for random rank-8 (add-one p=0.005). The restoration direction overlaps U_info at 0.905 (random 0.016). So U_info is the object L3H1 delivers, not an artifact of the output end.
intent_check.fulfils_prompt_forward_arm: Prompt forward arm had three parts. (1) 'which MLP-stage directions are causally changed by restoring L3H1' -- DONE: corruption suppresses the U_info-write of MLP3 (3.71->2.60) and MLP4 (5.00->4.02), and restoring L3H1 recovers them (3.63, 4.93); the U_info directions are the ones L3H1 restores. (3) 'where the signal resides' -- DONE: donor+/-5 restoration recovers 96% of the U_info routing, elsewhere only 6%. (2) 'which L4/L5 heads receive it' -- DEFERRED to 1c (head resolution).
intent_check.meet_in_the_middle: Object-level graph now spans the trace: L3H1 write (donor+/-5) -> MLP3/MLP4 assemble the acceptor-dependent U_info -> U_info at the final residual -> donor-G logit. The endpoints (1a: U_info reads out; 1b: L3H1 delivers U_info) are joined.

REFLECTION.per_block_reading: The U_info-write panel (descriptive, approximate -- ignores inter-layer LayerNorm, and measures WRITES at the donor, not routing) shows MLP3 and MLP4 are the main acceptor-dependent U_info writers; MLP5 writes U_info acceptor-INDEPENDENTLY (5.75->5.76 under corruption), i.e. a constant contributor; the L4/L5 attention writes little U_info at the donor. This does NOT contradict readout_path (where un-freezing L4/L5-attn adds margin recovery): that curve credits attention for ENABLING downstream propagation, which this write-magnitude panel does not measure. Characterizing the attention stages requires 1c.

checked: Near-tautology (h_re ~ h_cl, whose U_info-component is clean by construction): defused. Restoration is PARTIAL (R_L3=0.829), and F-Route is 93% not 100%, so a real 7% of L3H1's recovered margin flows through directions OUTSIDE the anchor's rank-8 U_info -- a genuine (small) second route, not an identity.
Specificity: the random rank-8 null tops out at 0.047, ~16x below R_U -- U_info is not just any subspace of the restored residual.
Localization is non-trivial: the elsewhere control recovers only 6%, so 'donor+/-5 carries it' is a real two-sided claim, not implied by construction.
R10: unconditional set, ratio-of-means; coupling +0.905 matches the known val range.
escaped_failure_modes.residual_risk: F-Align (0.905) is largely EXPECTED given F-Route is high -- h_re-h_co is a coupling-direction and U_info is the top-SVD of the coupling-direction h_cl-h_co, so their overlap is partly by construction. F-Align is corroboration, not independent evidence; the falsifiable weight is on F-Route (routes through U_info AND beats random) and F-Local. Also: the 7% non-U_info route and the attention stages' role are open and belong to 1c/1e.
